content.body:
## Outcome

A versioned, installable, documented first release is published and supportable.

## Exit criteria

- [ ] Release version, tag, changelog, and release notes are published.
- [ ] Python artifacts are built and installation is verified from a clean environment.
- [ ] Store-format/version compatibility and migration guidance are published.
- [ ] Quickstart builds and queries a representative store.
- [ ] Known limitations, support route, and contribution workflow are explicit.
- [ ] Post-release smoke tests pass against the representative portfolio.

## Dependencies

Blocked by Roadmap 3's release-candidate exit report.

content.body:
A stable base for API and website work: a stable engine, a running build pipeline, published Stores of each shape, and a catalog of every Analysis across them.

Each MVP lists the issues or criteria it needs. A box is ticked when its issue closes or its criterion is met. `/board` keeps the boxes current.

## Data architecture: stable opengwasdb

- [x] opengwasdb `dev` reads every Store below: format 0.1.0 (Zarr v2) and 0.2.0 (Zarr v3) are both supported

## Build architecture: build pipeline running

- [x] opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#282 stage 1 merged to `dev` (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#299). Stage 2 is not required.

## Store builds: a published Store of each shape

- [x] Ragged, cis: full eQTLGen, opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#314
- [x] Ragged, signals only: OGS-00006 (Chen 2023), rebuilt and published at format 0.2.0 (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#332)
- [x] Dense, Reference-Completed: OGS-00009 (UKB-B, the full 2,514 Analyses), opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#312
- [ ] Hybrid: OGS-00011 (GWAS Catalog EUR) rebuilt with its 3,169 Analyses, opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#225
- [x] Dense, multi-ancestry, observed-only: OGS-00012–OGS-00016 (MVP EUR, AFR, AMR, EAS, META), opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#331
- [ ] OGS-00006, OGS-00009 and OGS-00011 reach `validated`, so the catalog serves them: opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#332

The test for a Store is that opengwasdb can use it, not that it is the latest build. The catalog also serves a Store only once it is `validated` and its Validation Record matches its Release Manifest (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#313).
- OGS-00010 is retired under opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#312, so the new OGS-00009 takes the Dense Reference-Completed place.
- The published OGS-00011 holds 3,317 Analyses against its bundle's 3,169, so it is rebuilt.

- [ ] Explain OGS-00011’s 101M off-panel variants and verify MAF admission: opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#371

## Interface: analysis catalog

- [ ] opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#313

## Not required for this milestone

These continue as ongoing work:
- Reference Completion of OGS-00011 (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#334), which needs single-id completion for Hybrid Stores (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#333, #295);
- the Reference Completion of OGS-00006 (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#224), which needs single-id completion for Ragged Stores (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#336, #296) and the observed-SE fix in #301. It replaces the milestone's OGS-00006 under the same id;
- the rest of single-id reference completion (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#302);
- #282 stage 2;
- Reference Completion of the MVP Stores (opengwas/opengwasdb-stores#227–#230).
